notes: Read all 68 source lines with a numbered view before editing; this is the first web/src/components/maps file ported, so no native map host/index exists yet.

L1 `import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'`: preserved (both RN-compatible). Native additionally imports useState for the reduce-motion hook and React for the JSX runtime, matching the sibling parity files (RadialGauge/AIThinkingIndicator).

L2 `import { Marker, useMap } from 'react-leaflet'`: react-leaflet is DOM/Leaflet-only (contract rule 4) and there is NO map host in the native parity tree. Marker -> a self-contained RN View glyph; useMap()'s panTo keep-in-view is replaced by the optional `onRecenterRequest` host bridge (the explicit native unavailable state, contract rule 7).

L3 `import L from 'leaflet'`: leaflet is browser-only; dropped. L.divIcon/L.latLng have no native analogue — the icon HTML is re-rendered with RN View/Animated and L.latLng(position[0], position[1]) becomes the destructured `[lat, lng] = position` used in the accessibility label + the onRecenterRequest payload.
L4 blank line: preserved as import/section spacing.

L5-9 `interface AnimatedMarkerProps { position: [number, number]; heading?: number; color?: string }`: exported verbatim (same names/types). Native adds all-optional `onRecenterRequest` (the panTo bridge), `style`, and `testID` so the glyph is host-positionable and testable without changing the web contract.
L10 blank line: preserved.
L11 `/** Custom car icon rendered as a pulsing CSS circle with optional heading arrow. */`: preserved verbatim as the JSDoc on the native `CarIcon` component.

L12 `function createCarIcon(color, heading): L.DivIcon`: an L.divIcon factory cannot exist natively (no Leaflet); converted to a `CarIcon({color, heading, reduceMotion})` component that returns the same glyph as RN Views instead of an icon object.

L13 `const rotation = heading != null ? 'transform:rotate(${heading}deg)' : ''`: preserved as `transform: heading != null ? [{rotateZ: \`${heading}deg\`}] : undefined` on the inner dot — same null-guarded heading rotation, RN transform syntax.

L14-17 `L.divIcon({ className:'', iconSize:[24,24], iconAnchor:[12,12] })`: the 24x24 icon box + centered anchor become MARKER_SIZE=24 with the `icon`/`root` styles (width/height 24, alignItems/justifyContent center => the [12,12] center anchor). className:'' had no styling, dropped.
L18-19 outer `<div style="width:24px;height:24px;position:relative">`: -> styles.icon (width/height MARKER_SIZE, position 'relative') wrapping the two layers.

L20-24 pulse ring `<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:${color};opacity:0.3;animation:replay-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite">`: -> styles.pulseRing (absolute, full 24x24, borderRadius 12 = 50%) + inline backgroundColor:color. The `replay-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite` CSS animation (base opacity 0.3) is reproduced with an Animated.loop over PULSE_DURATION_MS=1500 + Easing.inOut(Easing.ease), interpolating opacity 0.3->0 and scale 1->1.7 (radar-style pulse). Reduce-motion users get the static opacity:0.3 base only.

L25-30 inner dot `<div style="position:absolute;inset:4px;border-radius:50%;background:${color};border:2px solid white;box-shadow:0 0 8px ${color};${rotation}">`: -> styles.innerDot (absolute, INNER_SIZE=16 = 24 - 2*4px inset, borderRadius 8 = 50%, borderWidth 2, borderColor BORDER_COLOR '#ffffff', shadowRadius 8 + shadowOpacity 0.9 + shadowOffset 0,0 + elevation 6 = the `0 0 8px` glow) + inline backgroundColor:color, shadowColor:color (the colored glow), and the L13 heading transform.
L31-32 close inner div + outer div: -> CarIcon's closing </View> tags.
L33-34 `})` close divIcon + `}` close createCarIcon: -> CarIcon return/close; CarIcon.displayName='CarIcon' added (parity-tree convention).
L35 blank line: preserved.

L36-41 AnimatedMarker JSDoc (smoothly transitions between positions; Leaflet owns the transform via setLatLng; inner child for heading rotation to avoid transform conflict): preserved + adapted into the AnimatedMarker doc comment and the file header, documenting that Leaflet positioning/auto-pan is the native unavailable state delegated to onRecenterRequest.

L42 `export function AnimatedMarker({ position, heading, color = '#00b4d8' })`: named export + prop names preserved; default color extracted to DEFAULT_COLOR='#00b4d8' (identical default). Native pulls reduceMotion via useReduceMotion() (AccessibilityInfo) instead of a markerRef/map.

L43 `const markerRef = useRef<L.Marker | null>(null)`: a Leaflet marker ref has no native analogue (the glyph is declarative, not an imperative Leaflet handle); dropped. The ref existed only to drive L52-53 setLatLng/setIcon, which native does via props.

L44 `const map = useMap()`: useMap() requires a react-leaflet MapContainer ancestor that does not exist natively; replaced by the onRecenterRequest host bridge (used at L56-57). This is the explicit unavailable-state substitution.
L45 blank line: preserved.
L46 `// Smoothly update position without re-mounting`: preserved as the comment on the native position-tracking useEffect.
L47 `useEffect(() => {`: preserved.
L48-49 `const marker = markerRef.current; if (!marker) return;`: the imperative-handle null guard is unnecessary natively (no ref); dropped — the effect body runs whenever the deps change.
L50 blank line: preserved (effect body spacing).

L51 `const target = L.latLng(position[0], position[1])`: L.latLng is Leaflet-only; the [lat,lng] pair is passed straight through as `position` to onRecenterRequest and destructured as `[lat, lng]` for the a11y label.

L52 `marker.setLatLng(target)`: Leaflet imperatively repositions the marker; natively the marker is re-rendered from the `position` prop, and the recenter intent is forwarded via onRecenterRequest?.(position).

L53 `marker.setIcon(createCarIcon(color, heading))`: imperative icon swap; natively redundant because <CarIcon color heading /> re-renders declaratively when color/heading change (color+heading are kept in the effect deps to mirror the web re-run trigger).
L54 blank line: preserved.
L55 `// Keep marker in view (but don't reset zoom)`: preserved as the doc note on the onRecenterRequest delegation.

L56-57 `if (!map.getBounds().contains(target)) map.panTo(target, { animate: true, duration: 0.3 })`: getBounds()/contains()/panTo() are map-host-only; with no native map the keep-in-view pan becomes `onRecenterRequest?.(position)`. When the host omits the bridge it is a no-op (explicit unavailable state); a host can implement the bounds-check + animated recenter itself.
L58 `}` close if: subsumed into the onRecenterRequest call.

L59 `}, [position, heading, color, map])`: dependency list preserved as `[position, heading, color, onRecenterRequest]` — `map` (the unavailable useMap handle) swapped for the `onRecenterRequest` bridge; position/heading/color kept so the effect re-runs on the same triggers as web.
L60 blank line: preserved.

L61-66 `return (<Marker ref={markerRef} position={position} icon={createCarIcon(color, heading)} />)`: the Leaflet <Marker> becomes an accessible RN <View> (accessibilityRole='image', accessibilityLabel 'Vehicle marker at {lat}, {lng}' so position data is surfaced, style escape hatch, testID) wrapping <CarIcon color heading reduceMotion /> — the same icon the web `icon` prop rendered. ref/position are consumed as described at L43/L52.
L67 `}` function close: preserved; AnimatedMarker.displayName='AnimatedMarker' added (parity-tree convention).
L68 trailing newline: preserved.

No react-leaflet/leaflet, DOM elements, Recharts, framer-motion, or old web-UI imports remain; only RN primitives (View/Animated/StyleSheet/AccessibilityInfo/Easing). StyleSheet keys + properties are alphabetized (react-native/sort-styles). Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`.
